claims.head: Hofer isn’t cursed against the Predators
claims.body: Hofer has been shaky against the Predators since 2023-24, well below his usual. It looks like a pattern, but across three seasons a goalie’s record against one team told us nothing about the next meeting. Expect the usual Hofer.
claims.nums: 6 starts against Nashville: .878 save percentage · .914 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Hofer’s record against the Predators.
claims.call: If Hofer starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .914 than to his .878 against the Predators.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 6 against Nashville, 2,687 shots against everyone else

check.rule: held if he starts and his save percentage is closer to his usual than to his record against this team; can't judge if he doesn't start

claims.head: Good looks against hopeful ones
claims.body: The Blues are the league’s best for shot quality, at the dangerous end; the Predators are one of the league’s worst, at the hopeful end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Blues and the Predators sit at opposite ends for shot quality.
claims.call: The Blues’ shots are more dangerous on average than the Predators’.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season

check.measure: how dangerous the average shot was
check.rule: held if the team comes out ahead by at least half its usual margin; partly if it comes out ahead by less; otherwise didn't happen

NSH.head: A slightly uphill night for Nashville
NSH.body: St. Louis has controlled the play far better over recent games and Nashville has home ice. Nashville’s best way to tip it is a penalty kill that holds up.

STL.head: Leaning St. Louis’s way
STL.body: St. Louis has controlled the play far better over recent games and Nashville has home ice. Not by much, though: Nashville can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.
